vault_line: Told her, "Take a step back," I don't deal with no regrets
bar: Told her, "Take a step back," I don't deal with no regrets
chip_form: Told her, "Take a step back," I don't deal with no regrets
note_excerpt: In this lyric, Che makes it clear that he’s not interested in being too friendly with any women, mostly because he knows that it will come with some regrets down the line. This lyric also serves as a callback to Ski Mask the Slump God’s 2017 album, YOUWILLREGRET, and one of Ski’s most popular songs
